metadata.description: A collection of AI plugins for various tasks.

plugins.name: architecture-skills
plugins.description: Architecture and design workflow skills for AI agents: recording decisions, comparing tradeoffs, designing interface contracts, reviewing dependency choices, designing failure behavior, building type-safe designs, and planning development containers.

plugins.name: code-explorer
plugins.description: Deep codebase exploration agent and phase skills for building evidence-based maps of unfamiliar repositories: structure, architecture, entrypoints, data flows, symbol inventory, dependencies, test coverage, risks, and change impact.

plugins.name: code-smith
plugins.description: Custom execution agents for scoped code changes and run-only verification from Planning Forge handoffs, raw plans, or ad-hoc tasks, with command-safety and reporting contracts.

plugins.name: commit-discipline-skills
plugins.description: Commit and pull request discipline skills for AI agents: cleaning branch history, drafting and auditing commit messages, and writing reviewer-ready pull request descriptions without rewriting history or posting live updates.

plugins.name: instructions-authoring
plugins.description: Instruction-authoring workflow skills for AI agents: creating portable instruction packages, writing and auditing controlled-English agent instructions, assessing agent skills for readiness, and diagnosing instruction defects.

plugins.name: model-panel
plugins.description: Custom agents for conditional, read-only multi-model routing, output comparison, raw-output retention, and evidence-grounded synthesis when the host supports the requested routes.

plugins.name: planning-forge
plugins.description: Custom planning agents for specifications, architecture, test plans, scoped prototype spikes, and user-requested documentation persistence where host tools permit.

plugins.name: review-forge
plugins.description: Custom agents for report-only multi-lens code review, including contextual, independent, security, performance, adversarial, and test adequacy lenses.

plugins.name: review-skills
plugins.description: Review workflow skills for scoping pull requests, improving review findings, planning root-cause fixes, managing review disagreements, and gatekeeping merge readiness.

plugins.name: specification-skills
plugins.description: Requirements and specification workflow skills for AI agents: auditing acceptance criteria, finding requirement ambiguity, sharpening requirements, defining scope boundaries, surfacing assumptions, enumerating edge cases, consolidating same-kind artifacts, and reconciling docs against the live source tree.
